faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BCKV Young Professional-I (YP-I) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the BCKV Young Professional-I (YP-I) recruitment is 22nd September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) post is M.Sc. (Horticulture) with at least 60% marks or an OGPA of 6.75 on a 10.00 scale. Knowledge in horticultural plant characterization and quality planting material production is also necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) post in this recruitment drive by Bidhan Chandra Krishi Viswavidyalaya (BCKV).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the BCKV Young Professional-I (YP-I) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the BCKV Young Professional-I (YP-I) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the BCKV Young Professional-I (YP-I) recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for the BCKV Young Professional-I (YP-I) recruitment can be found on the official website of Bidhan Chandra Krishi Viswavidyalaya (BCKV) at www.bckv.edu.in. A direct link is usually provided in the "Important Links" section of job notification articles.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) post?
faq.answer: The official notification should be referred to for specific age limit details. Age relaxation rules, if any, will also be detailed in the notification.

faq.answer: The job type for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) position is contractual.
